rules.mark_frequency: For every complete UTC evaluation day, replay the account-equity path at all nine closed one-minute boundaries strictly inside each of the 143 ten-minute holding windows, plus every execution boundary and the final liquidation. The expected interior-mark count is exactly 1287.
rules.boundary_prices: Entry, exit, and shared rebalance boundary marks use the same first verified aggregate-trade price used for execution. A one-minute kline may never replace a boundary execution reference.
rules.interior_prices: Interior marks use only the matching fully closed one-minute price. Missing, duplicate, extra, non-finite, or wrong-symbol marks reject the complete day.
rules.equity_path: At a shared boundary record pre-rebalance equity, then record post-rebalance equity after direct net-turnover cost at the same timestamp. Include funding only after its event time and apply final liquidation cost after the last pre-exit mark.
rules.risk_gate: Both the 5-bp base and 10-bp stress paths must independently have maximum minute mark-to-market drawdown at or below 15 percent during development and locked validation.
rules.conservatism: This is a one-minute mark-to-market drawdown measure, not a claim to have observed every sub-minute worst tick. Any later portfolio promotion still requires its separate daily MTM, leverage-adjusted MAE, ruin, and deterministic-stress gates.
